intro_zh: 本課學習用 -er + than 比較兩件事物的不同，例如 colder、drier 等形容詞比較級。透過生活情境，讓學生能描述今天和昨天、沙地和森林等的天氣與狀況的差異。
can_do: 能用 -er + than 比較兩件事物的溫度或乾濕度。
能閱讀並理解有關天氣與衣服的短文。
能口頭說出今天比昨天更冷或沙子比森林更乾的句子。

sentences.en: Lily and Max enter the forest on a cold morning.
sentences.zh: 莉莉和麥克斯在寒冷的早晨進入森林。

sentences.en: Today is colder than yesterday, so Lily wears a skirt and a sweater, while Max wears pants.
sentences.zh: 今天比昨天更冷，所以莉莉穿著裙子和毛衣，而麥克斯穿著長褲。

sentences.en: The sky is full of clouds, but it is not snowy today.
sentences.zh: 天空雲很多，但今天沒有下雪。

sentences.en: They feel the air is wet near the river, but the sand on the beach is dry.
sentences.zh: 他們覺得河邊的空氣很潮濕，但海灘的沙子很乾。

sentences.en: The sand is drier than the forest floor, so they sit comfortably.
sentences.zh: 沙子比森林地面更乾，所以他們坐得很舒服。

sentences.en: Max takes off his jacket because he feels hot, and Lily puts on a t-shirt.
sentences.zh: 麥克斯因為感到熱而脫下夾克，莉莉則穿上 T 恤。

sentences.en: Lily's shirt gets wet from the mist, but her shorts stay dry.
sentences.zh: 莉莉的襯衫因霧水變濕，但她的短褲仍然乾燥。

sentences.en: They change into dry clothes before walking back to the forest.
sentences.zh: 他們在返回森林前換乾衣服。

sentences.en: The sun burns their skin if they stay too long without a coat.
sentences.zh: 如果他們沒穿外套就在陽光下待太久，太陽會灼傷他們的皮膚。

sentences.en: At home, they drink warm water and feel happy after the day's adventure.
sentences.zh: 回家後，他們喝暖水，感到今天的冒險很開心。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① 比較級的拼字規則
grammar_points.explain_zh: 形容詞比較級通常在原形後加 -er。依照詞尾的不同，有以下拼寫規則：
table: y 後面接子音，改 y 為 i 再加 -er
重複字尾子音（重音閉音節）雙寫最後一個子音再加 -er
詞尾為 e，去掉 e 再加 -r
重複字尾子音（同上）雙寫最後一個子音再加 -er

grammar_points.title_zh: ② than 後面接被比較的那一個
grammar_points.explain_zh: 在比較句中，than 後面放被比較的對象，也就是較少或較弱的那一方。

examples.en: The sand is hotter than the forest.
Her coat is thicker than his jacket.
examples.zh: 她的外套比他的夾克更厚。

lines.en: The coat is warmer than the sweater.
The jacket is cooler than the coat.
The t-shirt is lighter than the sweater.
The skirt is drier than the pants.
The clouds are grayer than the sky.

sentences.en: The pants are wetter than the shorts.
The shirt is drier than the skirt.
The sweater is warmer than the t-shirt.
The jacket is cooler than the coat.
The coat is thicker than the jacket.
The snowy day is colder than the rainy day.
sentences.zh: 下雪的天比下雨的天更冷。

sentences.en: The forest is shadier than the sand.
The shorts are lighter than the pants.

grammar: 兩者相比用形容詞比較級 -er + than。

mcq.q: The sand is ______ than the snow. (比較...)
The snow is ______ than the sand. (比較...)
The shirt is ______ than the sweater. (比較...)
The snow is ______ than the cloud. (比較...)
The coat is ______ than the shirt. (比較...)

opts: No, I don't have a coat.

fill.q: This shirt is ____ than that shirt.（這件襯衫比那件濕）
That shirt is ____ than this shirt.（那件襯衫比這件乾）
The sand is ____ than the wet shirt.（沙子比濕的襯衫熱）
The coat is ____ than the shirt.（外套比襯衫熱）
The shirt is ____ than the coat.（襯衫比外套冷）
My pants are ____ than your pants.（我的褲子比你的褲子乾）
The forest is ____ than the snowy shirt.（森林比雪衣多雪）
This cloud is ____ than that cloud.（這雲比那雲濕）
That cloud is ____ than this cloud.（那雲比這雲乾）
The snowy shirt is ____ than the shirt.（雪衣比普通襯衫多雪）
